resources.string: Add this phone to your cloud
On your computer, open Bento › Settings › Devices › Add device and scan the QR code it shows.
Type the code your other device shows in Settings › Devices › Add device.
Point at the QR code on your other device.
That QR isn’t a Bento code for adding devices.
12 characters. You can also paste the link your other device shows.
I don’t have the other device
Use the same Telegram account as on your other devices.
Keep Bento open on both devices.
Open Bento on another device: you’ll see a notice to review this request.
Check that your computer shows these same emojis and press \"Add\" there.
Check that your other device shows these same emojis and press \"Add\" there.
Press \"Add\" on your other device if you haven’t yet. This phone only accepts access from that device.
Do you see the same emojis on your other device?
Compare them with the ones your other device shows after pressing \"Review\". If any is different, someone else answered this request.

resources.string: Since the emojis didn’t match, this phone accepted no access. Ask again or use your recovery code.
Your other device couldn’t sign in for you. Confirm it in the Telegram app on this phone, or scan the code with Telegram on another phone.
Your account has two-step verification. Enter the password you created in Telegram to finish.
Telegram › Settings › Devices › Link Desktop Device
Your other device chose \"Not me\". If it was you, create a new code and try again.
Codes last a few minutes. Create a new one on your other device (Settings › Devices › Add device).
The other device closed the pairing window. You can start again whenever you like.
Your cloud already exists in this account
Choose how to give this phone access. Your files stay encrypted until you approve it.
Ask my other devices for access
When you ask, you’ll see the same emojis here and on your other device to approve it.
With the kit you type or scan the 36-character code.
You don’t have a Bento cloud yet
This Telegram account doesn’t have a cloud yet. You can create it now from this phone.
Your photos and files will appear little by little. You can start using Bento meanwhile.
This phone is now part of your cloud.
This phone is already in your cloud
Bento is already connected here. To add another device, open Settings › Devices on this phone.
The code doesn’t match. Check that you typed it right or create a new one on your other device.
This code is no longer valid. Create a new one on your other device.
We couldn’t use the pairing service. Sign in to Telegram on this phone and ask your other devices for access.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
Telegram sign-in from the other device failed. Try again.
No connection. Check the internet on both devices and try again.
Another device answered this request. If it wasn’t you, cancel on the new device.
Your Telegram account has several Bento clouds and we don’t know which one to join. Use a pairing code or your recovery code.
That device was removed from your cloud, so it can’t come back with the same identity. Try again from the new device so it joins as a new one.
Something went wrong while pairing. Try again.
On the other device, open Bento, choose \"I already use Bento on another device\" and scan this code.
QR code to add a device
Link to join your Bento cloud
Check that the other device shows these same emojis.
If they don’t match, choose \"Not me\".
Waiting for \"%1$s\" to sign in to Telegram…
\"%1$s\" is now part of your cloud and is downloading your library.
The other device has no access to your cloud.
Create a new one when you have the other device at hand.
We couldn’t reach the service that connects your devices.
On the other device, sign in to Telegram and choose \"Ask my other devices for access\". The request will appear in Devices for you to approve.
A code couldn’t be prepared. Try again.
The action couldn’t be completed. Try again.

Compare these emojis with the ones the new device shows. If they match, add it.
